test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Our crops depend on the rainy season. Before the monsoon begins, farmers in communities begin their work in the fields. They irrigate their grounds and grow a variety of crops __________ for this season using the natural water supply.
solution:
```html
The correct answer is '**appropriate**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**appropriate**" means suitable or proper in the circumstances. (उचित)
 
• It fits well with the context of growing crops suitable for the rainy season using natural water supply.
 
• The other options: "**inadequate**," "**incompatible**," and "**manipulating**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Our crops depend on the rainy season. Before the monsoon begins, farmers in communities begin their work in the fields. They irrigate their grounds and grow a variety of crops appropriate__ for this season using the natural water supply.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Inadequate (अपर्याप्त)**: means lacking the quality or quantity required; insufficient.
 
• **Incompatible (असंगत)**: means not able to exist or work together without conflict.
 
• **Manipulating (हेरफेर करना)**: means controlling or influencing cleverly or unscrupulously.

```
